user.title: Choose a Grundfos pump
user.description: Pumps heard by a connectable Bluetooth proxy. Pairing works best with one connectable proxy close to the pump: the pairing belongs to the proxy that made it.

data_description.address: Grundfos pumps that a Bluetooth proxy able to make connections hears right now. A pump of a model this integration doesn't support yet is listed with its family and type numbers: adding it pairs with it and records what it says, for a request to support it.

collect_confirm.title: Add {name} for data collection
collect_confirm.description:
This integration can't read this pump yet. Adding it pairs with the pump once and records what it answers, which is what's needed to support it. No sensors are created and nothing is written to the pump.

Afterwards, open the integration's entry for the pump and choose **Download diagnostics**, then attach the file to a GitHub issue. The file leaves out the pump's Bluetooth address, serial number and name.

Submit to continue to pairing.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Pair with {name}

pair_failed.title: Pairing did not succeed
pair_failed.description: Submit to try again, then press the pump's Bluetooth button as soon as the waiting screen appears.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description:
The pump no longer accepts the encrypted link from Home Assistant. This is expected when the proxy holding the pairing was replaced or wiped. Submit, then press the pump's Bluetooth button.

Connectable proxies hearing the pump: {connectable}

reconfigure.title: Pair {name} again
reconfigure.description:
Pair the pump with the proxy that now hears it best. Submit, then press the pump's Bluetooth button.

Connectable proxies hearing the pump: {connectable}

progress.pair: Press the Bluetooth button on {name} now. Waiting up to a minute for the pump to open its pairing window, then connecting.

error.no_connectable_proxy: No Bluetooth proxy that can make connections hears this pump. An ESPHome proxy with active connections enabled is needed within a few metres of the pump; Shelly devices only listen.
error.button_timeout: The pump did not report a button press within a minute.
error.window_missed: The pump refused pairing: the connection through {source} took {seconds} s and arrived after the three-second window, or the button was pressed too early. Try again and press the button as soon as the waiting screen shows.
error.no_longer_in_range: The pump is not advertising right now. Make sure it has power (a thermostat may have switched it off).
error.unsupported_model: This Grundfos device (family {family}, type {type}) is not supported yet.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found: No devices found on the network
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device does not advertise like a Grundfos pump.
abort.unsupported_model: This Grundfos device (family {family}, type {type}) is not supported yet. Add it from Add integration to record what it says, then send the recording: see docs/new-pump.md in the integration's repository.

data_description.scan_interval: Each reading opens a short Bluetooth connection, usually a few seconds long. While Home Assistant is connected the Grundfos GO app cannot connect.

running_time_24h.name: Running time in the last 24 hours

proxy_forgets_bond.title: {proxy} forgets the pairing with {name}
proxy_forgets_bond.description:
The pump was paired through {proxy} and read once, and then refused that proxy within half an hour. ESPHome proxies built with ESP-IDF 5.5.6 (ESPHome 2026.10) forget a pairing after one connection, so pairing again would only repeat this.

Build the proxy with ESP-IDF 5.5.5 (ESPHome 2026.9) or a release that fixes it, or reboot it, and then pair the pump again from the integration's Reconfigure menu. Until then Home Assistant stops asking to re-pair.

proxy_cannot_pair.title: {proxy} cannot pair with {name}
proxy_cannot_pair.description: The ESPHome firmware on {proxy} has no pairing support, and the pump answers only an encrypted (paired) connection. Update ESPHome on that proxy. Pressing the pump's button cannot help.

unreachable.title: {name} has not answered for an hour
unreachable.description:
The pump is advertising and a connectable proxy hears it, but every reading for an hour has failed (last error: {error}).

Likely causes:
- The Grundfos GO app is connected to the pump; close it.
- The Bluetooth proxy needs a restart.
- The pump no longer accepts the pairing; pair it again from the integration's Reconfigure menu.

This issue closes by itself after the next good reading.

collect_only.title: {name} is added for data collection only
collect_only.description:
This integration can't read this pump yet (family {family}, type {type}), so it has no sensors. The frames recorded while pairing are in its diagnostics.

To ask for support: go to Settings > Devices & services > Grundfos Bluetooth, open the menu on {name}, choose **Download diagnostics**, and attach the file to a new-pump request on GitHub. Learn more explains each step. The file leaves out the pump's Bluetooth address, serial number and name.

Once an update supports the pump, this notice changes and offers to set it up with its sensors.

confirm.title: Read {name} as a supported pump
confirm.description:
This version of the integration can read this pump. Submit to connect to it with the existing pairing, read what it offers and add its sensors. No button press is needed.

If the pump no longer accepts that pairing, choose **Reconfigure** on it instead and pair again.

error.needs_pairing: The pump refused the existing pairing. Close this, then choose Reconfigure on {name} and press the pump's Bluetooth button.
error.still_unsupported: The pump reported an identity this version can't read after all. Please open an issue with its diagnostics.
